metadata.title: Mass ratio, the hills mechanism, and the galactic centre S-stars

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's S-star population is described as bound to the Galactic-centre SMBH, not as Galactic unbound. S5-HVS1 is mentioned as a previously known hypervelocity star ejected from the Galactic centre (T:p1-b10) and as an example whose former companion may be tidally disrupted (T:p6-b10); however, the paper does not explicitly state that S5-HVS1 is unbound from the Milky Way in its present-day state or establish a satisfied unbound criterion. The hypervelocity label and ejection alone do not qualify under the rules.
